|rulings=* The 1998 Glossary explains Death Star Assault Squadron through retrieval of one card; the 2002 supplement instead explains relocation through Vader’s persona.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary (1998)]], page 57; [[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], page 3.</ref> The source explanations are kept with their respective editions.
|strategy=By Dan Holmes, Red 31<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/evader.html</ref>

It has one used function and two lost functions, and the used one is the best. Cancel all Revolutions in play and the owner loses one Force for each. This is the best way to deal with [[Revolution]]. The Light Side loses 2 cards for each [[Revolution]] in play. (the [[Revolution]] card +1 more) Since [[Evader]] has a 4 for destiny, it is one that you will not mind returning to your Life Force.

The Lost uses are also good. You may lose [[Evader]] to move [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] or [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s Custom Tie to your Used Pile if it was just lost. In this manner, [[Evader]] is very much like a "back" card except that it does not cost you anything. If you wanted to use [[The Empire's Back]] to do the same thing, you would have to use 2 Force and lose the card.

The other lost use is to save any imperial just lost from a [[Death Star]] location to your Used Pile. This is great if you are playing with [[Lieutenant Suba]] or any other strategy that focuses on the [[Death Star]]. Clearly, [[Evader]] is a card that has to be considered one of the most useful cards in the SWCCG universe.
|notes=* Decipher published this errata as text only, in the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998). The main image is that entry. Printed face: [[Evader]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].
* Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered [[Evader (Revised)]] (September 1998), before the Glossary. That printing is its own version; the errata applies to the original black-bordered card.
* The card picture below it is a card made later with this text: the Players Committee's D-E1 card of 2 March 2023 ([[Evader (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]); its game text is word for word the Glossary Version 2.0 text.
